notes.title: Patch Notes | 16.09.2025
notes.notes: [h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h2][b]General:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improvements to AI behaviour to both enemy and story characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Various animation fixes and enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Amendments and improvements to the game’s UI and inventory screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous texture improvements throughout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to lead tracking where required.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced character, weapon, item and AI clipping against environments.[/p][/*][*][p]Kicks will now cause the expected flinch reaction on a successful hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dialogue timing and flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest notifications will no longer appear repeatedly at the top left of the screen every time the game is unpaused.[/p][/*][*][p]The Club, Mace, Police Truncheon, Cricket Bat, and Spiked Club will now generate blood VFX when striking enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Spore Mines are now correctly detected by Prescience or Attunement abilities before Cave.[/p][/*][*][p]After Bill Anderson drinks the flask and becomes Prior Ignatius, his name will no longer incorrectly display as “Bill Anderson” when highlighted.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Location notes.title: Small Fix Update
notes.notes:
[b]We've deployed a small fix to resolve a store issue for the Wicked Isle DLC. [/b]

A full list of fixes from our most recent patch can be found [url=https://t.co/A5ERGtnG21]here [/url]
We hope that everyone has been enjoying the expansion.

notes.title: Patch Notes | 03.06.2025
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved haptic feedback when drawing the bowstring
[*] Outro cutscenes will skip as intended after selecting the 'Skip Cutscene' option when finishing a mainline quest
[*] Toggling radios on/off will no longer alert Protocol Soldiers
[*] Enemies will no longer attack the player during conversations with NPCs or quest givers
[*] Button icons now appear correctly when using a Steam Controller
[*] The melee weapon aim tracker now adjusts correctly when switching to a crouched position
[*] Rifle ammunition stock now replenishes for Molly and Bootsy when they restock
[*] Player can no longer trigger a slide when there was not enough room to do so to ensure it is more difficult to walk off edges
[*] The toggle for the “Hold” option will affect direct recipe clicks in the crafting menu as intended
[*] Added ‘Hide Crosshair’ option to remove the crosshair and hit markers from the HUD
[*] General stability and performance improvements
[*] Improvements to game and menu UI
[*] Animation fixes and enhancements
[*] Lighting and texture improvements 
[*] Improvements to localisation and translations 
[/list]

[h1]Location Specific Fixes
Slatten Dales[/h1]
[list]
[*] NPCs in cleared camps will no longer respawn after reloading a save
[*] Enemies no longer get stuck on the ramp near the entrance to the Waterwheels 
[/list]

[h1]Wyndham Village[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, players could become stuck near the truck on the road to the Band Stand in Wyndham Village
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur after leaving the Bakery in Wyndham Village
[*] Protocol Soldiers will no longer shoot the water when they detect leeches
[/list]

[h1]Casterfell Woods[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved AI behaviours 
[*] Wasps will now spawn from the nest as intended after the player transitions out/ into the woods
[*] The plant near the pond in the garage will trigger as intended 
[/list]

[h1]Skethermoor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Two wooden posts have been separated to avoid clipping inside the Feed Mill 
[*] Fixed an issue where Outlaws could fire from unintended positions
[/list]

[h1]Interchange[/h1]
[list]
[*] The second plant mine in Data Store Alpha in the Interchange will now open without the player needing to be extremely close
[*] The glass on the MOD entrance control room is now the same on both sides
[/list]

[h1]Lead Specific Fixes (potential spoilers)[/h1]

[list]
[*] Dr Garrow will no longer become hostile and attack the player if they shoot Dr Holder to save her in the Interchange control room
[*] Joyce Tanner will now appear correctly when finishing her quest
[*] The map location will update correctly to reflect the convoy crash site
[*] Fixed an issue where the Batteries Not Included achievement would not unlock 
[*] The scientist from the beginning of the game no longer incorrectly reappears during the Mystery Voice’s ending
[*] Fixed an issue where Mother Jago would request her book again even after already receiving it in a previous exchange
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes | 16.04.2025
notes.notes:
[h1]General Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where some players would experience random movement and stuttering with their mouse
[*] Player's orientation will no longer change dramatically after autosaving
[*] Fixed an issue where the map would sometimes become stuck on only one region
[*] Fixed an issue where the Inventory occasionally kicked the player from storage tubes
[*] Resolved an issue where subtitles were disappearing too quickly
[*] Improved translations for (Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and French)
[*] Fixed an issue where weapon ammo could go missing when equipping or moving weapons between quick slots
[*] ‘Already Learnt’ message will no longer remain permanently in the Inventory section
[*] Resolved an issue in which the map’s region list would not expand if the 'Pause in Menus' setting was enabled
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur when players traded for weapons while they had full ammo
[*] The pin of explosive lures is no longer visible after the player has pulled the pin out
[*] Combat music tracks will now shuffle so players have a lower possibility of hearing the same combat track twice in a row
[*] Resolved an issue where players were unable to turn off the Developer Console
[*] Ammo will no longer disappear after equipping a gun to a slot and then dropping the same weapon
[*] The description for the Modified JM-3 and other JM-3 variants now read correctly as fully automatic
[*] The Equipment Shortcuts tutorial no longer shows a bandage in a quick slot as this is not possible in game
[*] The 'Content Installed' notification for Deluxe Edition players on Epic now has correct formatting
[*] The 'Purchase' text in the DLC screen is has now been translated in Japanese
[*] The Privacy Policy has now been localised in the crash reporter
[*] Descriptions have been added for Melee Assist (Strength and Rotation) options
[/list]
 
[h1]Quest Specific Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The correct outro will now be played when the player completes the game with Mother Jago’s ending in all circumstances
[*] Resolved an issue where, under certain circumstances, Joyce Tanner did not appear at her ending location
[/list]
[h1] 
Wyndham Village[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck under the building after exiting The Bakery
[*] Training stimulants will no longer respawn in the Forgotten Cellar
[*] Resolved an issue where the bushes near the bandstand would flicker when players got close
[/list]
[h1] 
Casterfell Woods[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, under certain circumstances, players could get stuck in the transition space between the Castle Ruins door and the woods
[*] A non-existent house no longer appears on the map for the open area near the village gate
[/list]
 
[h1]Skethermoor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where sounds could become muffled on entering the container in front of the Master Control room in the Prison
[/list]
[h1] 
Interchange[/h1]
[list]
[*] The door to Lower Robotics is now accessible if players complete the puzzle, exit, and then return
[*] Players will now have safe passage if they do not have enough health or health items to exit the spore cloud and leave Medical
[*] Punch cards have been replaced with correct cards
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes | 27.03.2025
notes.notes:
[h3]ATOMFALL DAY 1 UPDATE FIXES[/h3]
In addition to [b]general bug fixing and gameplay improvements[/b] the latest title update to Atomfall addresses the following issues:

[h3]Global[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an overlapping issue in subtitles, playstyle warning messages, and barter screens 
[*] Fixed an issue where in some circumstance the AI would not escalate to combat 
[*] Fixed an issue with NPCs (such as Molly, Joyce) getting hostile with you after attacking them once and conversing continuously with them during gameplay
[*] Fixed an issue where Throwable weapons could clip through the metal barricades 
[*] Fixed an issue with Spits from ferals not generating a PFX, making it hard to see their trajectory
[*] Fixed issues where the alarm audio did not stop on exfil 
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple characters could turn hostile when the player used tools nearby
[*] Saves from different game versions are now able to be loaded
[*] Improved how AI populates when loading an autosave
[*] Player ammo and trader material counts now appear correctly after bartering
[*] Fixed an issue where the outro fails to trigger after closing the backpack opened before the end of the conversation and after selecting the escape option during gameplay
[*] Fixed a cutoff issue in tooltip bar relating to some Russian characters in the menu
[*] Fixed where item name and description could remain on screen after picking item up in Backpack 
[*] Fixed an issue where the ‘Save game time’ text appeared too long
[*] Added translations for landmines 
[*] Updated text for Field Time User Setup and Field of View slider
[/list]

[h3]Slatten Dales[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the effect of the torch in shadowed areas of Slatten Dales 
[/list]

[h3]Wyndham Village[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player failed to progress the quest 'Sims wants me question Dr Garrow' if they retrieved the information from Dr Garrow before receiving the quest
[/list]
[h3]
Casterfell Woods[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced character clipping through the platform while getting down from the platform near wooden logs in Casterfell Woods
[*] Improved takedown animation when crouching
[*] Fixed a collision issue on the rock present near the broken building in the Old Watermill in Casterfell Woods
[*] Updated lighting to make it easier to find Mother Jago's book in the castle
[*] Fixed progression issue when the player fails to progress through the quest on interacting with Mother Jago after picking up the Growth Serum and the book of Herbalism during the gameplay 
[*] Fixed an issue with Druids and Mother Jago appearing hostile towards the player character on entering the Castle Ruins for exfil during gameplay if you antagonised them previously
[/list]

[h3]Skethermoor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash on PS4 which occurred when players idle in Skethermore for too long 
[/list]

[h3]Interchange[/h3]
[list]
[*] Power on and power up sound in Radio Tower and Robotics Lab now fixed
[/list]

Please continue to send us your bug reports. Including screenshots, video clips and full descriptions of the issues you might encounter will be hugely beneficial. Our Player Support portal is [url=https://support.rebellion.com/hc/en-gb]here[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/801800/Atomfall/

notes.title: Atomfall from Rebellion is Steam Deck Verified ahead of release
notes.notes:
Rebellion are set to release Atomfall on March 27th, their survival-action game inspired by real-life events set in Northern England. The good news is that it's Steam Deck Verified already.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/atomfall-from-rebellion-is-steam-deck-verified-ahead-of-release/
